messages:
Maya: heads-up — main CI just flipped red after the auto-merge (build 4829). failing step: `smoke-e2e-gpu`. link: https://ci.redwood/builds/4829 
CI-bot: build 4829 FAILED in step 'smoke-e2e-gpu' (exit 137). logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/4829/logs 
Kevin: grabbing logs now, pinging @Olivia oncall 
Olivia: oncall here, I see OOMs across a couple of xla shards. I'll queue a rerun of the smoke matrix: `ci rerun 4829 --step smoke-e2e-gpu` 
Maya: rerun queued, thanks. if rerun passes, likely transient. if it fails again we should bisect to the last merge (PR #1234) — who merged it? 
Raj: that was me, i merged #1234 earlier today. i'll take a look — can try to repro locally on xla-2. 
Kevin: if Raj can't repro, consider a fast revert since this blocks other merges. rerun ETA? 
CI-bot: rerun started (job 4830) — triggered by Olivia at 1748512400 
Olivia: rerun status: partial green on cpu shards, still failing on xla-2 with kvalloc errors. attaching the failing snippet:
```
E kvalloc: failed to allocate 256MB from pool (node xla-2)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ... allocator.cpp:line 214
```
Raj: that's interesting — my change touched a tiny allocator path but shouldn't affect pool sizes. i'll run the same smoke config locally: `./run_smoke --shard xla-2 --smoke=true` and report back in ~15. 
Maya: thanks Raj. If bisect points at #1234 i'll cut a revert PR and coordinate a fast rollout. adding label `ci-blocker`. :thumbsup: 
Kevin: pinging release and infra teams so they're aware in case we need a hot revert. @release @infra 
Olivia: i'll keep PagerDuty on standby if the rerun continues failing. :rotating_light: 
Raj: quick update — reproduced the OOM on my dev vm with xla-2 config. narrowing down now, looks like allocation path differs when `--enable-kvcache` is on. 
Maya: good catch. keep this thread for updates, once Raj narrows root cause we'll decide revert vs patch. thanks everyone for fast responses.
